taste:
This roast centres on rich, savoury pork and the contrast between tender meat and crisp crackling. The slow-roasted slices have a melt-in-the-mouth texture, while the salty crackling gives each mouthful a sharper crunch. A generous pour of rich gravy brings the pork and its accompaniments together, making this a hearty plate rather than a lighter meal.

The large Yorkshire pudding adds another crisp element alongside the golden roasted potatoes. Fresh seasonal vegetables give the plate variety without taking the focus away from the meat. Served steaming hot, it suits someone who wants the familiar combination of roast pork, crackling and traditional Sunday accompaniments.
